lines.en: Ximena, did you hear? The match was cancelled because of the rain.
lines.pt: Ximena, você soube? A partida foi cancelada por causa da chuva.

lines.en: Oh no! I was looking forward to it. When was it cancelled?
lines.pt: Ai, não! Eu estava ansiosa por ela. Quando foi cancelada?

lines.en: This morning. The fans were told to keep their tickets.
lines.pt: Hoje de manhã. Os torcedores foram avisados para guardar os ingressos.

lines.en: Was the stadium damaged by the storm?
lines.pt: O estádio foi danificado pela tempestade?

lines.en: Not really, but the field was covered with water. It was too dangerous for the players.
lines.pt: Na verdade não, mas o campo foi coberto de água. Era perigoso demais para os jogadores.

lines.en: Were the tickets sold out? I bought mine last month.
lines.pt: Os ingressos estavam esgotados? Comprei o meu mês passado.

lines.en: Yes, they were all sold two weeks ago. Mine was a gift from my brother.
lines.pt: Sim, foram todos vendidos duas semanas atrás. O meu foi presente do meu irmão.

lines.en: So when is the new game? I hope it isn’t in the middle of the week.
lines.pt: Então quando é o novo jogo? Espero que não seja no meio da semana.

lines.en: The club said it was moved to next Saturday. The coach was happy about it.
lines.pt: O clube disse que foi adiado para sábado que vem. O técnico ficou feliz com isso.

lines.en: Good. The first game of the season was also cancelled last year.
lines.pt: Bom. O primeiro jogo da temporada também foi cancelado ano passado.

lines.en: Yes, I remember. Let’s meet at the gate and have some hot chocolate.
lines.pt: Sim, lembro. Vamos nos encontrar no portão e tomar um chocolate quente.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio: The match was cancelled. The tickets were sold. Para dizer quem fez, use by: damaged by the storm.

facts.label: Foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio quando o foco é a coisa, não quem agiu: The match was cancelled. The tickets were sold. Use was no singular e were no plural.

facts.label: Perguntas com was/were
facts.sub: Inverta was/were e o sujeito: Was the stadium damaged? Were the tickets sold out? Respostas curtas: Yes, it was. No, they weren’t.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “a partida foi cancelada” e “os ingressos foram vendidos”.
compare.us: Em inglês, o passivo no passado usa was/were + particípio: The match was cancelled. The tickets were sold. Com by, dizemos quem fez: damaged by the storm.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The match was cancelled.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We form the passive past with was/were + participle.

items.why: We say The match was cancelled.

items.s: By + person shows who did the action: damaged by the storm.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We form the passive past with was/were + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes: was cancelled, were sold.)
We say “The match was cancel.” → Falso (We say The match was cancelled.)
By + person shows who did the action: damaged by the storm. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is a wet Saturday in Chicago. Ana is near the stadium with her friend Carla. A big match was planned for tonight. The streets are full of fans in team shirts. Nobody is playing in the rain. Carla has the latest news.

“Ana, did you hear? The match was cancelled because of the rain.” says Carla. “Oh no! I was looking forward to it. When was it cancelled?” says Ana. “This morning. The fans were told to keep their tickets.” says Carla.
